title: orchis tridentata var. hanrii
intro:
Orchis tridentata var. hanrii, commonly known as the Hanrii's orchid or Orchis hanrii, is a plant species in the Orchidaceae family, characterized by its unique morphology and medicinal properties.

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as arthritis, digestive issues, and skin problems.

The therapeutic actions of Orchis tridentata var. hanrii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit analgesic, anti-spasmodic, and anti-epileptic effects.

Research on the bioactive constituents of Orchis tridentata var. hanrii has identified the presence of iridoids, phenylethanoid glycosides, and other compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
